notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.8

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 Released
notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.7
1. Game optimization and bug fixes.
2. The idle screen has been added.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Released
notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.6
1. Fixed an issue where parts were not acquired properly.
(Insufficiently acquired parts are recovered by running the game after patch)
2. Fixed minor issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Released
notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.5
1. Fixed an issue where grade was not updated when retry.
2. Fixed an issue of moving to another stage when retry.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Released
notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.4
1. The Retry, Continue button has been added to the stage result menu.
2. The text color has been changed according to the grade.
3. Added deaths text where select and result menu.
4. Fixed an issue of not being able to select a stage in progress in the Select menu.
5. Fixed an issue that was shown to be skill enabled even when the skill was disabled.
6. Finishing attacks and a riposte attack speed increased by 15%.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Released
notes.notes:
What's New in Version 1.0.3
1. Improving Tutorials.
2. Fixed prologue event errors.
3. Fixed Text rendering issues.
4. Fixed a bug where keyboard system keys could not be mapped.
5. Fixed minor issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Released
notes.notes:
[b]What's New in Version 1.0.2[/b]
1. Fixed stage rank issues
2. Fixed the problem that the last stage rank was unconditionally F
3. Fixed a problem where the stage clear time was not saved
4. Fixed minor issues

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.notes:

1. Fixed door's issue.
2. Fixed the 4-10 stage crash problem.
3. Fixed a memory chip display problem.
4. Fixed a problem that were slowing down on restart.
